title: NetworkPresenceChangedPayload
description: network.presence.changed v1 (OpenVibe.Network server/presence; plan 2026-10-22 track X item 9). A person's public presence changed: their chosen state, status line, emoji, the show_status switch, or the derived online/away/offline state. OpenVibe.Network writes it to its outbox beside the presence row, at most once per person per 30 seconds (the debounce), and only for a real change. The payload is the public view in network.presence@1: invisible and show_status off are sent as offline with no status text or emoji, so the event never carries what the person hid. Envelope: subject { type: user, id: <usr_…> }, visibility internal, actor the person. A presence change is not a reason to notify anyone.

state.description: The public state. Never invisible: an invisible person is sent as offline, without their status text or emoji.

live.description: Streaming on OpenVibe.Live now; false while invisible or with show_status off.
